subject: Kickoff: close choreography / dependency signalbox for MSA + DPA + order form
messages:
From: Sarah Klug <sarah.klug@heliomed.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: close sequencing & MAP for HelioMed pilot (MSA/DPA/order form)

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for taking this on. We want to lock the procurement and legal sequencing for the HelioMed pilot so we can hit the target launch in November. Attached is our rough SOW (HelioMed_SOW_v0.pdf) so you can see the scope. Key asks from Procurement/Legal:

- Clear list of sign-off artifacts (MSA, DPA, Order Form, SOW) and which must be signed before provisioning.
- Estimate for internal HelioMed review turnaround for each doc (~legal, security, procurement).
- A mutually agreed MAP with milestone dates we can push to our Steering Committee next week.

Can you propose a MAP that sequences review and signatures? We would like to run DPA review in parallel with SOW edits if possible to shorten cycle, but our legal ops insists MSA needs final countersign before any paid provisioning.

Note: procurement@heliomed.com is looped for scheduling availability.

Thanks — happy to do a short call if that helps.

—Sarah
Sarah Klug
Head of Strategic Procurement | HelioMed
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klug <sarah.klug@heliomed.com>
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: close sequencing & MAP for HelioMed pilot (MSA/DPA/order form)

Sarah —

Appreciate the SOW and the clear asks. High level response and proposed MAP below; attaching a short sequencing note and the MSA draft for your legal to review (redwood_msa_draft_20261001.docx).

Summary proposal (short):
- Week 1 (Oct 5-11): Redlines on SOW. HelioMed legal & procurement to review SOW; Redwood to respond to SOW redlines.
- Week 1-2 (Oct 5-18): DPA review runs in parallel with SOW edits — privacy/security can review the DPA concurrently; we'll provide a DPA FAQ to accelerate.
- Week 3 (Oct 19-25): Final MSA negotiation window — target countersign by Oct 25. MSA signature required before provisioning (per your note).
- Week 4 (Oct 26-29): Order Form finalization and DocuSign cycle; provisioning target the first week of Nov.

Key sequencing constraints and rationale:
- MSA: Redwood legal requests final MSA countersign prior to creating a paid instance (billing/provisioning). We can, however, begin technical onboarding and run non-production evals under an NDA if helpful.
- DPA: We can minimize blocker risk by running DPA review in parallel; HelioMed security may request specific SOC2 evidence — we'll surface that in the DPA FAQ.
- Order Form: order form contents depend on final SOW and any agreed SLA tweaks; recommend a short (2–3 day) internal HelioMed procurement sign-off window once SOW and MSA are agreed.

I've copied Marcus (legal) and Irene (customer success / onboarding) — Marcus, Irene: can you confirm the markup windows below and flag any items that must be sequential vs parallel? I linked a draft MAP here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-helm-map-draft (preview only).

Attachments: redwood_msa_draft_20261001.docx

Next step: Sarah — if that schedule looks sensible I'll put together a mutual action plan doc with milestone owners and firm dates and send a DocuSign order-form stub for parallel review. If you prefer a 20–30 min alignment call tomorrow we can do that.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: close sequencing & MAP for HelioMed pilot (internal)

Folks —

Quick internal note on sequencing and risk mitigation (pulling from MSA draft and similar deals):

1) Parallelize where possible
   - DPA review + SOW redlines: strongly recommend running them in parallel. DPA comments rarely change commercial terms and can be handled by our privacy team in parallel.

2) MSA timing is the gating item
   - MSA needs countersign before provisioning or billing. Recommend we accept a limited provisioning exception (non-production eval instance) if HelioMed signs a commitment letter or statement of work that is explicitly non-billable until MSA is countersigned. This avoids lost time on technical onboarding.

3) Order Form approach
   - Draft an order form that references the MSA by version and the SOW by version. Keep the order form intentionally minimal (term, seat counts, start date placeholder) so it can be signed quickly after MSA finalization.

4) Evidence & attachments
   - Prepare a short packet: SOC2 snapshot, architecture diagram, and the DPA FAQ.

Action items for us (owners):
- Marcus: finalize a redline-ready MSA with minimal optional clauses (done — attached).
- Irene: prepare the onboarding runbook and a provisioning-limited non-prod instance template to offer HelioMed during MSA negotiation.
- Mateo: draft the MAP with milestone owners and circulate to HelioMed.

I'll plan to be available for a quick review with HelioMed legal if they want to do a live redline session.

Attachments: redwood_msa_draft_20261001.docx

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Klug <sarah.klug@heliomed.com>
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: close sequencing & MAP for HelioMed pilot (MAP & next steps)

Sarah / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Per Marcus/Irene notes above, attached is a short order-form stub and the MSA draft we referenced. I've also drafted a 3-week MAP (attached as a one-pager in the Drive link) with named owners and target dates — high level:

- Oct 5–11: HelioMed SOW review & initial redlines (owner: HelioMed legal)
- Oct 5–18: DPA review & evidence exchange (owner: Redwood privacy / HelioMed security)
- Oct 19–25: MSA negotiation window — target countersign Oct 25 (owner: legal teams)
- Oct 26–29: Order Form sign & DocuSign cycle (owner: procurement)
- Nov 1: Provisioning & onboarding kickoff (owner: Redwood CS)

If HelioMed is comfortable with this sequencing we propose the following concrete options to accelerate:
- Option A (fastest): HelioMed confirms SOW redline window of 3 business days and allows DPA review to run fully in parallel. MSA final by Oct 25.
- Option B (conservative): HelioMed requests live redline calls for MSA; schedule those Oct 19–21 which may push order form sign to the following week.

Please reply with: preferred option (A or B), confirmation of internal reviewers and their expected turnaround times, and whether you want us to drop a brief DocuSign order-form for parallel review. Attached is preliminary_orderform_stub.pdf for your procurement to review.

Thanks — we can also stand up a 20-minute alignment call tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Mateo
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
Attachments: preliminary_orderform_stub.pdf
